races.name: William Hill Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Flying Ace
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with decent Irish form who should appreciate the step up in trip and good ground conditions.
runners_data.comment: Ran well for a long way on hurdle debut at Downpatrick; probably the one to beat
runners_data.spotlight: Third in an Irish point; beaten 20l in a bumper and even further on hurdle debut at Downpatrick, though did run well for a long way latterly; every chance in this weak a race.

runners_data.name: Military Cross
runners_data.note: Well-bred prominent type making hurdles debut but brings solid Flat form and is interesting switched from the Gosdens.
runners_data.comment: Sufficient ability and stamina on the Flat to believe he could make a hurdler
runners_data.spotlight: Seven-race maiden for the Gosdens but suffered a few near misses at up to 1m6f; made a quiet stable debut on the Flat (tongue tied after wind surgery) but that was in a strong handicap at York; could make a hurdler.

runners_data.name: Etretat
runners_data.note: Confirmed front runner who flopped badly at Perth but gets a significant drop in grade and more suitable track layout.
runners_data.comment: 150-1 on hurdle debut at Perth and performed accordingly
runners_data.spotlight: Left Charlie Johnston for 1,000gns; 150-1 on hurdle debut at Perth and performed accordingly.

runners_data.name: Masekela
runners_data.note: Low-grade hold-up horse making hurdles debut with poor recent form and needs major improvement to compete.
runners_data.comment: Low-grade Flat performer; 25-1 and tailed off in a good-ground maiden at Hexham
runners_data.spotlight: Low-grade Flat performer who joined this yard for £5,000; 25-1 and tailed off in a good-ground maiden at Hexham.

runners_data.name: Ribble River
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with three Flat wins but struggling over hurdles, tongue-tie applied and 47 days since last run.
runners_data.comment: Three wins on the Flat but it's been a poor start to his hurdling career
runners_data.spotlight: No great shakes on the Flat for Kevin Ryan but did win three times at about 1m4f; however, it's been a poor start to his hurdling career.

runners_data.name: Colinski
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with Flat-winning form who showed promise on hurdles debut despite the margin of defeat.
runners_data.comment: Modest Flat winner; ran better on hurdle debut (good/soft) than margin of defeat suggests
runners_data.spotlight: Won a Class 6 handicap on the Flat last year over 1m3f (on good ground); ran better on his hurdle debut at Hexham (good to soft) than his margin of defeat may suggest; this surface will suit him better.

runners_data.name: Big Gypsy King
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with poor recent form, 220 days off the track, and concerning tendency to fade in the finish.
runners_data.comment: Tailed off in both runs over hurdles and no worthwhile Flat form in the meantime
runners_data.spotlight: Tailed off in both runs over hurdles and no worthwhile Flat form in the meantime.

races.paceDynamic: Etretat is the only confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the start without pressure in this small field. Military Cross and Flying Ace are likely to sit prominent but neither has shown strong early pace, creating a moderate tempo through the early stages. The lack of genuine pace pressure will allow the leaders to conserve energy for a sustained finish. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can track the modest pace and hold-up horses with a turn of foot, as the gentle gallop will produce a sprint finish where class and acceleration matter most.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Lead Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Etretat gets an easy lead and jumps cleanly throughout
scenarios.body: The front runner faces no pace pressure and can dictate ideal fractions, making it hard for hold-up horses to reel him in on Cartmel's tight track. His stamina advantage becomes decisive in the final furlong when others tire from their finishing efforts.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Military Cross and Flying Ace track Etretat closely and put pressure on turning in
scenarios.body: The two higher-rated prominent runners use their class advantage to wear down the leader and pull clear of the hold-up brigade. Their superior form and ratings tell in a sustained battle from three out.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Springs
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes crawling and sets up a sprint finish from the last hurdle
scenarios.body: The lack of early gallop plays into the hands of a hold-up horse with a turn of foot who can quicken dramatically. Colinski's Flat speed or an improving Ribble River could exploit the tactical scenario.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Benefits Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses make jumping errors or the pace collapses completely
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery where ratings and form count for less than a clear round of jumping and tactical positioning. An unfancied runner like Masekela stays out of trouble and picks up the pieces.

watchPoints.text: Etretat's jumping ability after flopping badly at Perth - any early mistakes will compromise his front-running tactics completely.
Military Cross settling kindly on hurdles debut with Richie McLernon - if he fights for his head early, it ruins his chance.
The pace through the first circuit with only one natural leader - a crawling gallop could set up a sprint finish.
Colinski's jumping fluency after showing promise but making mistakes on debut at Hexham.
Big Gypsy King's fitness levels after 220 days off and whether his finishing kick has returned.

races.name: In Memory Of Jimmy Latham Selling Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Book Of Secrets
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with solid course form but hasn't won since 2023, carrying top weight with 10-pound claimer
runners_data.comment: Only 7l away when fourth at Newcastle (2m1f) in March and remains on a good mark
runners_data.spotlight: Only 7l away when fourth at Newcastle (2m1f, good to soft) in March and remains on a good mark; without a win since 2023 but has possbilities; Leah Noreci is his regular partner.

runners_data.name: Character Testing
runners_data.note: Front-running type who remains winless over hurdles in 15 attempts despite decent placed form at this level
runners_data.comment: Flat winner who is 0-15 over hurdles, though does have placed form off this mark
runners_data.spotlight: Flat winner who is 0-15 over hurdles, though does have placed form off this mark; it wasn't too bad a run 19 days ago at Market Rasen.

runners_data.name: Zamond
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning after 167 days but showed good form at Newcastle last time, proven on good ground
runners_data.comment: Absent since December but that was a good run at Newcastle; has form here
runners_data.spotlight: Absent since December but that was a good run at Newcastle (2m1f, good to soft) and he has competitive form here on good ground; one to consider.

runners_data.name: Zhang Fei
runners_data.note: Confirmed front runner dropping into seller for first time, carried 5-pound claimer, struggling over hurdles lately
runners_data.comment: His penultimate Flat run was encouraging and this is his first time in a seller
runners_data.spotlight: Has struggled over hurdles since rejoining this stable but his penultimate Flat run was encouraging and this is his first time in a seller.

runners_data.name: Mojo Ego
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with strong course record including two runner-up finishes here, disappointing last two runs
runners_data.comment: Could bounce back around here where he was twice runner-up over C&D last summer
runners_data.spotlight: His last two runs have been disappointing but he could bounce back around here where he was twice runner-up over C&D last summer.

runners_data.name: Frank Stamper
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with two seconds this year but ran desperately just 10 days ago at this level
runners_data.comment: Twice runner-up this year but he did run desperately only ten days ago
runners_data.spotlight: Relegated into a seller and he has form claims, having finished runner-up on two occasions this year; however, he did run desperately only ten days ago.

runners_data.name: Justlikefire
runners_data.note: Patient runner coming off promising Uttoxeter second before fall, below that level most recent start
runners_data.comment: In pretty good form until his remote second at Hexham; now goes in a tongue-tie
runners_data.spotlight: Second to progressive rival at Uttoxeter (2m, soft) in November and running well before penultimate-flight fall next time; below that level when a remote second at Hexham but he's better than that and now goes in a tongue-tie.

runners_data.name: Alvesta
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare receiving significant weight allowance but longstanding maiden with no recent improvement signs
runners_data.comment: Longstanding maiden and no recent evidence to suggest she's about to put that right
runners_data.spotlight: Longstanding maiden and no recent evidence to suggest she's about to put that right.

runners_data.name: Restandbethankful
runners_data.note: Prominent runner on 56-day break, underwhelming last three efforts mixing codes
runners_data.comment: Stuck on a losing run and last three efforts thoroughly underwhelming
runners_data.spotlight: Mixes chasing with hurdling and he's stuck on a losing run; last three efforts thoroughly underwhelming.

runners_data.name: Silent Revolution
runners_data.note: Hold-up veteran whose form has been regressing, made no impact on recent stable debut
runners_data.comment: His good days are long gone and he has been regressing for a while
runners_data.spotlight: His good days are long gone and he has been regressing for a while; made no impact on stable debut.

runners_data.name: Mr Globalist
runners_data.note: Prominent type winless in 37 career starts, beaten long way in non-handicap seller last time
runners_data.comment: Longstanding maiden and beaten a long way in a non-handicap seller last time
runners_data.spotlight: Yet to win in 37 runs Flat and jumps; beaten a long way in a non-handicap seller last time.

runners_data.name: Mr Rumbalicious
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse 5 pounds out of weights with another headgear change, course winner in 2023
runners_data.comment: C&D winner in 2023; currently out form and he's 5lb out of the weights
runners_data.spotlight: C&D winner in 2023; currently out form and he's 5lb out of the weights; another change of headgear.

runners_data.name: Hashtag Queen
runners_data.note: Hold-up type 13 pounds out of weights on handicap debut, limited ability despite trying cheekpieces
runners_data.comment: Lightly raced but looks limited and she's 13lb out of the weights on handicap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Lightly raced but looks limited and she's 13lb out of the weights on handicap debut; tries cheekpieces.

races.paceDynamic: Zhang Fei will take the field along from the front as the only confirmed leader, likely joined by Book Of Secrets and Character Testing in the early stages. With Zhang Fei struggling over hurdles recently and the prominent runners showing mixed form, the pace should be sustainable rather than punishing. This tactical setup strongly favours hold-up horses like Zamond, Frank Stamper, and Justlikefire who can benefit from the steady gallop and position themselves for late strikes. The race shape clearly suits patient tactics over early positioning.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Zhang Fei sets a modest pace and the prominent runners fail to sustain pressure
scenarios.body: The steady gallop allows the back-markers to get into contention turning for home, with Zamond's class and Frank Stamper's recent placed form proving decisive. Both horses have the tactical speed to win from off the pace when the race develops this way.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Book Of Secrets or Character Testing can dominate the pace-setting Zhang Fei and maintain strong positions throughout
scenarios.body: The early leaders get first run on the field and their superior fitness tells in the closing stages. Book Of Secrets' experience at this level and Character Testing's recent run give them the edge over tiring hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If Zhang Fei stops quickly and the prominent runners also weaken, creating a sprint finish from the back
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure means multiple horses arrive with chances, favouring those with the best recent form regardless of style. Mojo Ego's course form and Justlikefire's Uttoxeter second become crucial factors in a bunched finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Zhang Fei improves dramatically dropping into a seller for the first time and gets an uncontested lead
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows Zhang Fei to dictate terms completely and his stamina proves superior to pursuing horses. His recent Flat form suggests untapped potential that this class drop might unlock.

watchPoints.text: Zhang Fei could get an uncontested lead if the other prominent runners fail to go forward early enough
Book Of Secrets and Character Testing must show pace early or risk being trapped behind a slow tempo
Frank Stamper's recovery from his poor run 10 days ago will indicate if he can bounce back to recent placed form
Zamond's fitness after 167 days off will be crucial given his hold-up style requires a strong finishing kick
Several horses carrying significant weight penalties or out of the weights could struggle in the closing stages

races.name: Traffic Management Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Beny Nahar Road
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer returning from 253-day break but previous course form over this trip suggests he can overcome the rust factor.
runners_data.comment: Capable 7yo but he has been off since falling over fences in September
runners_data.spotlight: Better chaser than hurdler but handicapped accordingly and has placed form in this discipline; however, he has been off since falling over fences in September.

runners_data.name: Sea The Clouds
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with strong course form who nearly won this race last year and ran well here recently despite disappointment.
runners_data.comment: Nearly won this last year and ran well in a competitive Class 2 last time
runners_data.spotlight: Has plenty of form around here over hurdles and fences, and very nearly won this race 12 months ago off 1lb higher (under Charlotte Jones); ran surprisingly well when 125-1 for a Class 2 at Haydock last time; in the mix.

runners_data.name: Hillview
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse improving since Sean Bowen took over, though lacks recent winning form to fully trust.
runners_data.comment: Had struggled after returning from a long absence but last time was a bit better
runners_data.spotlight: Had struggled after returning from a long absence but last time was a bit better and Sean Bowen now takes over; could be interesting, for all that he's not shone around here in the past.

runners_data.name: Dickens
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with consistent form when last seen but 197-day absence and lack of recent run creates uncertainty.
runners_data.comment: This mark is very manageable but he does lack a recent run
runners_data.spotlight: In a consistent run of form when last seen in November, mostly hooded but also in just a tongue-tie last time; this mark is very manageable but he does lack a recent run.

runners_data.name: Musique De Fee
runners_data.note: Natural leader but running her third race in five days which makes her vulnerable over this longer trip.
runners_data.comment: Second here on Saturday and third on Monday in first-time blinkers; beaten 22l latterly
runners_data.spotlight: Second here on Saturday and third on Monday in first-time blinkers, though she was some 22l off the winner; opposable should she run yet again.

runners_data.name: Got Grey
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse switching from Dan Skelton but disappointed badly in chase here on Monday which raises immediate concerns.
runners_data.comment: Ex Skelton horse who was last of the three to finish over fences here on Monday
runners_data.spotlight: Capable hurdler/chaser for Dan Skelton but signed off for that yard on a downer and was last of the three to finish in a chase here on Monday; unraced over this far.

runners_data.name: Lowlands
runners_data.note: Prominent runner bringing momentum from Perth maiden win and could handle this handicap mark on that evidence.
runners_data.comment: Made all in a Perth maiden so brings momentum into her handicap return
runners_data.spotlight: Consistent mare who made all in a 2m4f maiden at Perth (good) and therefore brings momentum into her handicap return; this mark could be okay.

runners_data.name: Rioja Alta
runners_data.note: Prominent type with course-and-distance winning form though disappointed last time at Perth.
runners_data.comment: C&D winner off 2lb lower last summer (soft) and some respectable runs in the meantime
runners_data.spotlight: C&D winner off 2lb lower last summer (soft) and some respectable runs in the meantime; the latest at Perth wasn't one of them but he's hard to rule out.

runners_data.name: Swingingonthesteel
runners_data.note: Prominent runner making handicap debut after bumper wins but showed nothing in maiden hurdles previously.
runners_data.comment: Won bumpers but disappointing so far over hurdles; makes handicap debut here
runners_data.spotlight: The winner of three bumpers, the first in points; beaten at odds-on in his first maiden hurdle and has shown nothing since, so goes handicapping with much to prove.

runners_data.name: Rauzan
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with tongue-tie added after Kelso disappointment and has placed form over similar distances.
runners_data.comment: Below par last time but previous efforts firmly bring him into the equation
runners_data.spotlight: A tongue-tie is added after his Kelso disappointment and his two previous runs in 2m5f/2m3f handicaps certainly bring him into the equation; unraced here.

runners_data.name: Bittalemon
runners_data.note: Front-runner with course wins over shorter trips but dropped out tamely over longer distance here on Saturday.
runners_data.comment: Dual course winner but dropped out very tamely in a 3m1f handicap here on Saturday
runners_data.spotlight: The winner of two 2m1f novice events here (good to soft/good) last summer; however, she dropped out very tamely in a 3m1f handicap here on Saturday.

races.paceDynamic: Musique De Fee and Bittalemon are the two natural pace-setters, with Musique De Fee running her third race in five days after showing prominent tendencies in blinkers, while Bittalemon has won twice leading at this track over shorter trips. Sea The Clouds, Lowlands, and Rioja Alta will likely sit prominent just behind the leaders, creating a decent gallop over this extended 2m6f trip. The pace should be honest but not frantic, with the real business happening from the final hurdle as the stamina test kicks in. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can stay the trip and finish, as the pace-setters are vulnerable late having had recent hard races.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the pace-setters weaken markedly in the final half-mile after setting honest fractions.
scenarios.body: The extended trip and recent exertions of the front-runners create perfect conditions for closers to sweep past tired leaders. Horses with tactical speed who can stay this demanding distance will have clear runs through tired horses.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners can secure the ideal position tracking the pace without getting involved early.
scenarios.body: Sea The Clouds or Lowlands can sit in the perfect stalking spot and have enough left to outstay both the pace-setters and hold off the closers. Their recent form and course experience becomes crucial in a tactical finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If both Musique De Fee and Bittalemon fail to handle their recent exertions and drop out before halfway.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy affair with no clear pace, suiting horses who can adapt tactically and quicken when needed. Mid-division runners who can adjust to the changing tempo will benefit most from the lack of early pace.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Musique De Fee's recent runs have actually sharpened her up rather than weakened her for this longer trip.
scenarios.body: Despite her heavy schedule, the mare's class tells and she can dictate throughout, with her early pace advantage proving decisive. Only horses who can live with her early speed will have a chance of reeling her in late.

watchPoints.text: Musique De Fee may not handle her third run in five days over this extended trip having raced Monday and Saturday
Bittalemon's stamina limitations were exposed over 3m1f on Saturday and this 2m6f trip may still stretch her
Beny Nahar Road returning from 253-day absence but Jamie Hamilton's 7lb claim could prove significant if fitness holds
Got Grey disappointed badly as favourite in chase here on Monday which suggests current form is questionable
Sea The Clouds has strong course form and nearly won this race last year off similar mark under Charlotte Jones

races.name: Join Rebecca Menzies Racing Club Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Poetry Man
runners_data.note: Front-runner wearing first-time visor showed improvement on Monday but has history of disappointing over fences
runners_data.comment: Third here on Monday and if turned out again he'd command a level of respect
runners_data.spotlight: After three successive pull-ups over fences he got back on track when close up in a 2m6f handicap hurdle here on Monday when in a first-time visor; if turned out again he'd command a level of respect.

runners_data.name: Wee Alki
runners_data.note: Prominent racer in excellent form with a recent Hexham win, returning claimer is a positive angle
runners_data.comment: Thriving 7yo who looks sure to put up another good account of himself
runners_data.spotlight: Doubled his hurdle tally over nearly 3m at Hexham this month and that was on the back of good runs in defeat; raised 6lb but has placed form under the returning Rebekah Duffy who claims 7lb.

runners_data.name: Evenwood Sonofagun
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who won over course and distance last year, back to form after wind operation on Monday
runners_data.comment: Comfortable winner here on Monday and must have every chance with a penalty
runners_data.spotlight: Won the 2m6f handicap on this card 12 months ago and returned to form with a 2l success over that same trip on Monday (following a wind operation); did that comfortably and must have every chance under a penalty.

runners_data.name: Secret Secret
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with three course wins over shorter but disappointed behind Evenwood Sonofagun on Monday
runners_data.comment: Goes well here but was only fifth behind Evenwood Sonofagun here on Monday
runners_data.spotlight: Three course wins over 2m6f; below par in two races before finishing fifth behind Evenwood Sonofagun here on Monday; has to step up.

runners_data.name: Jack Sprat
runners_data.note: Prominent racer switching yards from Jamie Snowden, 40 days off but showed decent form for previous connections
runners_data.comment: Capable on his day for Jamie Snowden, winning three times; recruited for £12,000
runners_data.spotlight: Capable on his day for Jamie Snowden, winning three times; didn't sign off for that yard in bad form and he joined this one for £12,000; could go well.

runners_data.name: Ebselysees
runners_data.note: Prominent racer in great form with two recent wins over 3m+ trips, raised another 7lb but handles these distances
runners_data.comment: Something has clicked after back-to-back wins at Perth; feared after a 7lb rise
runners_data.spotlight: Ex-Noel Williams mare; since a quiet yard debut she's won 3m/3m2f handicaps at Perth (good/good to soft), the latest by a comfortable 8l; raised another 7lb but something has evidently clicked.

runners_data.name: Kingofthegame
runners_data.note: Prominent racer who was a fading third over fences here on Saturday, back hurdling without headgear
runners_data.comment: Third over fences on Saturday (2m5f); his stamina could be stretched over this far
runners_data.spotlight: A fading third over fences here on Saturday (2m5f, good) when all headgear was left off; back hurdling off 1lb higher (out of the weights) and stamina could be stretched over this far.

runners_data.name: Dusky Days
runners_data.note: Front-runner in poor form lately, tailed off behind Wee Alki and faded to sixth here on Monday
runners_data.comment: After a break he's been tailed off behind Wee Alki and here on Monday faded into sixth
runners_data.spotlight: After a break he's been tailed off behind Wee Alki and here on Monday faded into sixth over 2m6f; others preferred.

runners_data.name: Gustavo Goodway
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with concerning pull-up record and 162 days since last run, hard to recommend
runners_data.comment: Recently won a couple of small-field points but he's opposable back under rules
runners_data.spotlight: Won a 2m6f handicap hurdle when trained in Ireland but was pulled up in three successive handicaps last year for Joanne Foster; opposable, despite since winning two small-field points since.

runners_data.name: I Am Spider Man
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who hasn't won for nearly two years but recent seconds over 3m+ show he retains ability
runners_data.comment: Nearly two years since he won a race but arrives here after solid seconds
runners_data.spotlight: Nearly two years since he won a race but arrives here after solid seconds in handicaps at about 3m2f; surprising to see the hood missing but he's still much respected.

runners_data.name: Defying Gravity
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse wearing new headgear combination, lightly raced 6yo with quirky tendencies
runners_data.comment: Near miss over fences two runs back; unseated early on Sunday; has his quirks
runners_data.spotlight: Lightly raced 6yo; in this new headgear combination when a late mistake (and some wandering) cost him a 3m chase at Perth and again he showed some quirks when ducking right and unseating at the first fence at Kelso on Sunday; capable of having a say on this return to hurdling but comes with an element of risk.

races.paceDynamic: Poetry Man and Dusky Days will contest the early lead, with both natural front-runners likely to set an honest gallop over this marathon 3m1½f trip. Poetry Man showed renewed vigor in his visor on Monday and should prove the stronger pace-setter, while Dusky Days has been disappointing lately and may fold earlier. The sustained tempo will stretch the field and create a genuine staying test. This honest pace will favor the prominent racers and strong finishers who can close from midfield, disadvantaging pure hold-up horses who need a muddling pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Honest Gallop Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If Poetry Man and Dusky Days maintain a true pace through halfway
scenarios.body: The sustained tempo plays to the strengths of prominent racers like Wee Alki and Ebselysees who can track the pace and kick when it matters. Hold-up horses struggle to make up ground in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Poetry Man gets an easy lead with Dusky Days failing to go the pace early
scenarios.body: The visor-wearing Poetry Man gets first run on his rivals and proves hard to peg back despite his modest recent form. His early positioning advantage becomes decisive over this stamina-sapping distance.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes overly strong and the front-runners tire dramatically
scenarios.body: The honest gallop sets up perfectly for I Am Spider Man and Evenwood Sonofagun to use their proven staying power. These battle-hardened stayers pick up the pieces when the pace-setters fade in the final half-mile.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Moderate Pace Setup
scenarios.trigger: If both front-runners go off too fast early and subsequently crawl
scenarios.body: The lack of sustained pace allows hold-up horses to get into contention but creates a messy tactical affair. The moderate tempo suits versatile sorts who can adapt their position during the race.

watchPoints.text: Poetry Man could get an uncontested lead if Dusky Days fails to go the early pace and dominate tactically
Wee Alki's claimer Rebekah Duffy taking 7lbs off a horse in excellent form makes them very dangerous
Evenwood Sonofagun showed a return to form on Monday after wind surgery and loves this course
Jack Sprat switching from successful Snowden yard to new connections after 40-day break creates uncertainty
Gustavo Goodway's 162-day absence and three successive pull-ups make him hard to trust despite his Ireland win

races.name: Birchall Trust Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Off The Jury

runners_data.name: Hostile Hotelier
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with 0-6 chase record suggests jumping reliability concerns, though recent poor Hexham run came over longer trip.
runners_data.comment: Four-time hurdle winner who is 0-6 over fences despite a lower mark
runners_data.spotlight: Four-time hurdle winner who is 0-6 over fences (despite a lower mark) and was beaten a good way at Hexham (3m) on his return to this discipline after a break; the other two appeal more.

runners_data.name: Caughtinyourtrance
runners_data.note: Front-running style perfectly suited to small field dynamics, recent course form excellent and quick return suggests confidence.
runners_data.comment: Dual winner here over hurdles and ran second over fences here on Saturday
runners_data.spotlight: Both wins over hurdles were here; runner-up in two of his four chase starts, the latest here on Saturday when no match for the winner over 3m1f; fine over this far and has clear claims.

races.paceDynamic: Caughtinyourtrance will dictate terms from the front in this small field, with his confirmed leading style facing no obvious early pressure from either Hostile Hotelier (prominent) or Off The Jury (hold-up). The pace should be sustainable and measured over 2m5f, allowing the leader to control fractions without being harassed early. Off The Jury will need to rely on his strong staying power from the back, while Hostile Hotelier must position prominently to strike. This controlled tempo clearly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can avoid a finish reliant on pure acceleration.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Caughtinyourtrance Controls All
scenarios.trigger: If the leader faces no early pressure and dictates comfortable fractions
scenarios.body: Caughtinyourtrance gets an uncontested lead and kicks clear approaching the final fence, with the pace never quick enough to expose his stamina. The hold-up horse Off The Jury cannot generate enough late momentum to reel in the controlling leader.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Challenge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If Hostile Hotelier travels strongly and challenges turning for home
scenarios.body: The prominent runner gets first run on the leader while Off The Jury is still gathering momentum from the rear. Hostile Hotelier's superior finishing kick from a forward position proves decisive in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Stays Strongest
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes genuinely strong or the leader weakens
scenarios.body: Off The Jury's superior stamina comes to the fore as front-runners tire, allowing his patient hold-up tactics to pay dividends. His recent wind operations prove no hindrance as he stays on powerfully past tiring leaders.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Hostile Falls Again
scenarios.trigger: If Hostile Hotelier fails to handle fences under pressure as before
scenarios.body: The prominent challenger makes crucial jumping errors when asked to quicken, leaving a straight fight between leader and hold-up horse. Caughtinyourtrance's superior jumping rhythm sees off Off The Jury's late challenge.

watchPoints.text: Hostile Hotelier's jumping technique under pressure - his 0-6 chase record suggests fundamental issues when asked to quicken
Off The Jury's jumping fluency early - any signs of laboured breathing could indicate wind operations haven't fully resolved issues
Caughtinyourtrance's stamina reserves in final half-mile - quick return from Saturday's 3m1f defeat may tell late
Early pace development - if Hostile Hotelier or Off The Jury show more early speed than expected, it undermines the control scenario
Charlotte Jones' front-running tactics on Caughtinyourtrance - any deviation from aggressive leading style would signal stamina concerns

races.name: JJ Crossfield's Sundowner Handicap Chase

runners_data.name: Zumbi
runners_data.note: Prominent runner without his 10lb claiming jockey after narrow defeat here Saturday, faces quick turnaround
runners_data.comment: Hasn't won for ages but nearly put that right when going down by a neck here on Saturday
runners_data.spotlight: Hasn't won for ages but nearly put that right when going down by a neck here on Saturday (2m5f, good); Leah Noreci rode then so he's without the 10lb claim this time; still respected with cheekpieces added.

runners_data.name: Ghasham
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse making chase debut for new trainer, showed clear ability when second at Hexham
runners_data.comment: Second on stable\chase debut and the winner has gone in again since; same mark
runners_data.spotlight: Flat/hurdle winner who left Dan Skelton for 4,400gns; finished a clear second at Hexham (1m7f, good to soft; effective on good) on stable/chase debut and the revitalised winner has struck again since; gets in here off the same mark.

runners_data.name: Prospect House
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner returning after 162-day break but has won twice at Cartmel previously
runners_data.comment: Successful when last seen in December; if fit enough he should be on the scene
runners_data.spotlight: Runner-up on his only previous run here and returns on the back of a third chase win, gained at Catterick in December (1m7f, good to soft; fine on good); if fit enough then he should be competitive off a fair mark.

runners_data.name: Cuzco Du Mathan
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with three career wins all at Cartmel but struggling for form this year
runners_data.comment: All three career wins have been here, though on soft and heavy ground
runners_data.spotlight: Not in flying form earlier this year but all three career wins have been at Cartmel, the last two over fences; the concern is the conditions as he does enjoy significant cut underfoot.

runners_data.name: Clean Getaway
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who prefers Sedgefield but has placed here before, 47 days since last run
runners_data.comment: Usually saves his best for Sedgefield but two visits here has produced a second place
runners_data.spotlight: Usually saves his best for Sedgefield, where he won over fences in April (subsequent fourth was over hurdles); two visits here has produced a second place; no surprise to see him run well.

runners_data.name: Starman
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who was close second at Catterick but poor efforts since including selling hurdle
runners_data.comment: Close second over fences at Catterick in January but mainly poor efforts since
runners_data.spotlight: Close second over fences at Catterick in January (1m7f, good) but mainly poor efforts since, the latest in a selling hurdle.

runners_data.name: Beat The Edge
runners_data.note: Prominent runner extremely hard to win with despite low weight, inconsistent performer
runners_data.comment: Extremely hard to win with and modest runs outweigh the good ones these days
runners_data.spotlight: Extremely hard to win with and modest runs outweigh the good ones these days.

races.paceDynamic: Clean Getaway will lead with Zumbi tracking prominently, setting a measured gallop that shouldn't stretch the field early. The majority hold-up horses (Ghasham, Prospect House, Cuzco Du Mathan, Starman) will be content to settle behind this moderate tempo. With no genuine speed horse to inject pressure, the pace will be sustainable throughout the 2m1½f trip. This tactical setup strongly favours the hold-up horses who can produce their finishing kicks from off the steady pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace remains moderate as expected with Clean Getaway leading uncontested.
scenarios.body: The patient hold-up brigade will have too much finishing speed for the prominent runners over this trip. Ghasham and Prospect House particularly benefit from being able to unleash their kicks from the back.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Fight Back
scenarios.trigger: If Zumbi and Clean Getaway increase the tempo mid-race to blunt the closers.
scenarios.body: The two prominent runners use their tactical positioning to dictate terms and make it a staying test. Their earlier positioning gives them the edge when the hold-up horses come hunting.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Local Specialist Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Cuzco Du Mathan overcomes his moderate recent form to reproduce his Cartmel brilliance.
scenarios.body: The triple Cartmel winner uses his intimate course knowledge to find the perfect route through. His proven ability at this unique track trumps current form concerns.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the early leaders go too slowly and create a messy sprint finish.
scenarios.body: The moderate pace becomes almost pedestrian, leading to a chaotic bunched finish where any horse can win. The superior class horses struggle in the scramble.

watchPoints.text: Clean Getaway setting too slow a pace early - if he crawls the field home it creates chaos
Prospect House fitness after 162-day layoff - any signs of rustiness will end his chances quickly
Zumbi handling the quick turnaround from Saturday's narrow defeat in testing conditions
Ghasham jumping on chase debut - any novicey errors will cost him in a tight finish
Cuzco Du Mathan early positioning - needs to be closer than usual given his poor recent form
